$comment: EXAMPLE of an org-enforced policy. Deploy to C:\Program Files\ClaudeCode\managed-settings.json (Windows), /Library/Application Support/ClaudeCode/managed-settings.json (macOS), /etc/claude-code/managed-settings.json (Linux/WSL) — via MDM, a package, or the claude.ai admin console (server-managed). Nothing in user/project/local settings or --settings can override these keys. Verify on a machine with /status: 'Setting sources' shows 'Enterprise managed settings (file)'. We could not install this here: writing to Program Files needs local admin, which this laptop doesn't have.
